    -> Targets (chooses between players, npcs and a wall check)

    -> Angle (swings at anything near your crosshair)
    -> CPS (the click speed range it swings at)
    -> Limit to items (only swings while the sword is held)
    -> Region check (swings at anything in your sword region)
    -> Require mouse down (only swings while you hold click)
    -> GUI check (stops swinging while a menu is open)
    -> Show target (box on whoever it is swinging at, with its own colour)
